text:
incidents-bot: Pager: metering-anomaly detected · token-count drift for GOLD customers · threshold 3% · current 4.8% · overage flags firing · auto-escalation to on-call.

maya (oncall): oncall acked — looking. any customer-facing alerts?

sam: I see a spike in emitter retries from the EU cluster starting ~1716000500, could be duplicate records causing double-counting.

jorge: copying logs now. suspect kafka consumer rebalances + emitter backoff.

lee: billing pipeline shows delayed window writes around 1716000300-1716000900, some batches were retried and re-emitted.

maya (oncall): thanks. severity? are customers billed incorrectly yet?

alice Billing: a handful of customers received overage emails (automated) at 1716001100, small sample (5 customers). emails were triggered by the overage-flag worker.

maya (oncall): immediate mitigation plan: 1) pause overage-notifications for GOLD tier, 2) throttle emitter retries in EU, 3) start recount job for affected windows. can someone pause notifications?

billing-bot: /pause_overage_notifications --tier GOLD --requester maya --ticket 78934 --status queued

sam: throttling emitter retries on eu-emitter-prod now (cmd):
```bash
kubectl set env deploy/eu-emitter RETRY_BACKOFF_MS=5000 -n infra || true
```

lee: confirmed delayed writes are from the batch-ack path — consumer reprocess wrote duplicates because offset commit failed. pushing a hotfix to consumer to detect duplicate message id.

maya (oncall): good. can we get a quick snapshot of token deltas by customer for the last 3 hours? sam/lee?

sam: running ad-hoc query, will paste results.

sam: (snippet)
```sql
select customer_id, sum(tokens) as tokens_emitted, sum(tokens_expected) as tokens_expected, (sum(tokens)-sum(tokens_expected))/sum(tokens_expected) as pct_delta
from meter_windows
where window_start >= '2024-12-01T00:00:00Z' and window_start <= '2024-12-01T03:00:00Z'
group by customer_id
order by pct_delta desc
limit 10;
```

sam: top affected: cust_842 (delta +12%), cust_119 (delta +9%), cust_303 (delta +6%). most are GOLD.

maya (oncall): customer impact: potential overcharge on a small set. notify CS to hold off automated bill adjustments until recount completes.

alice Billing: notif to CS sent: "Hold on auto refunds/adjustments — we are reconciling token counts from 00:00-03:00 UTC; will update by EOD."

jorge: starting a targeted recount/replay job to de-dupe messages and produce corrected windows. job id replay-171600-1. ETA ~25m.

maya (oncall): rolling plan: 1) pause notifications (done), 2) throttle retries (done), 3) run recount (in progress), 4) when recount finishes validate counts and re-enable notifications. keep me updated every 15m.

billing-bot: overage-notifications pause complete for tier GOLD.

sam: replay job started. logs: 
```
[1716001280] replay-171600-1: reprocessing topic=emitter-prod partition=4 from offset=11234567 to 11235678
[1716001350] de-dup detected 482 duplicates skipped
```

lee: hotfix patch rolled out to consumer: add idempotency check on message_id header. patch version consumer-v2.3.1. Gradual rollout -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%.

maya (oncall): thanks. any remaining customers getting alerts?

alice Billing: none since pause. legacy queued emails still in mail queue but held.

sam: replay job ETA 18m. current progress: 60% processed, duplicates found ~520 total.

maya (oncall): ok. when replay finishes, run reconciliation diff and generate corrected metrics. we'll need to issue refunds or bill adjustments if counts reduce.

jorge: reconciliation diff job succeeded at 1716001780. summary: total tokens corrected -2.4% system-wide for window; for affected customers see corrected report attached to ticket 78934.

maya (oncall): good. action items: 1) billing to hold adjustments until manual review (alice); 2) CS to draft customer comms for those 5 affected (alice + CS); 3) eng to follow up on consumer patch and postmortem (sam/lee/jorge).

alice Billing: review started. will coordinate with CS and send provisional comms by 1716002400.

maya (oncall): postmortem owners? sam (emit pipeline), lee (consumer patch & rollout), alice (billing impact), maya (incident coordination). I'll open an incident doc.

billing-bot: overage-notifications will remain paused until manual resume by alice Billing.

maya (oncall): wrapping up live mitigation — will keep thread open for updates, but paging is resolved. moving to monitoring mode.

sam: quick note: consider adding message_id validation earlier in pipeline to avoid double-counting on retries.

lee: +1 and add metric for duplicate count rate.

jorge: logging improvement: capture commit failures with consumer offset metadata to help triage faster.

maya (oncall): thanks team. incident severity P2 (customer-facing but small sample). follow-up: full postmortem and remediation checklist due in 48h.

incidents-bot: Incident update recorded -> incident-1716001234 · status: mitigated · severity: P2.

maya (oncall): closing live pager. will reopen if new alerts. :wave:
